items.title: $1.1B stolen from crypto in 6 months: Ethereum and Solana lost $658M combined
items.whyYouShouldCare: The significant theft of $658 million from Ethereum and Solana highlights vulnerabilities in their ecosystems, potentially impacting user trust and liquidity.

items.title: Morgan Stanley is using $7.4 trillion in client assets and rock-bottom fees to hijack Wall Street’s crypto boom
items.whyYouShouldCare: Morgan Stanley's entry into crypto with substantial client assets could intensify competition for Solana, affecting its market positioning and user acquisition strategies.

items.title: SpaceX is a battleground Solana must win
items.whyYouShouldCare: SpaceX's involvement in Solana could be crucial for its growth, as partnerships with high-profile companies can enhance ecosystem usage and attract more developers.
